entities.summary: Nino Niederreiter is a Swiss professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Winnipeg Jets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected fifth overall by the New York Islanders in the 2010 NHL entry draft, making him the highest-drafted Swiss hockey player in NHL history at the time. Niederreiter made his NHL debut with the Islanders early in the 2010–11 season before being returned to his junior club, the Portland Winterhawks of the Western Hockey League (WHL). Prior to coming to North America, Niederreiter had played in the junior system of the Swiss team HC Davos and appeared in three playoff games for the senior club in 2010.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Nino Niederreiter's selection as the fifth overall pick in the 2010 NHL entry draft marked a significant milestone for Swiss hockey, paving the way for future generations of Swiss players to succeed at the highest level. His achievement has contributed to the growth and popularity of ice hockey in Switzerland.
